Point, path, segment, text and polygon layers in three dimensions

Source: R/layers-primitives.R
geom_point_3d.Rd

Point, path, segment, text and polygon layers in three dimensions

Usage

geom_point_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_path_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_segment_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_text_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  orientation = "screen",
  plane = NULL,
  normal = NULL,
  up = NULL,
  facing = NULL,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_polygon_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard ggplot2 layer arguments.

orientation

Text layers: "screen" draws labels upright on the page, "plane" draws font outline geometry in three dimensions.

plane

Text plane spanned by "xy", "xz" or "yz"; defaults to "xy" when neither normal nor facing is supplied.

normal

A finite nonzero numeric triple, the plane normal in normalized panel coordinates. Supply one of plane, normal or facing.

up

A finite nonzero reading-up hint in normalized panel coordinates. With normal, defaults to the z axis (y for a z normal). Camera-facing text defaults to the camera's reading-up direction. A parallel hint uses the least aligned coordinate axis to define the reading direction.

facing

"camera_plane" gives labels a shared view-facing normal; "camera_point" faces each anchor toward the perspective eye. Parallel projections use the reversed sight ray, including oblique shear.

Value

A ggplot2 layer emitting unprojected scene geometry.

Details

Large point clouds: geom_point_3d(render = "splat") draws each point in a raster backend as a sphere of the point's size, depth-tested per pixel, and darkens points by eye-dome lighting, so an unlit cloud shows its depth structure. edl (default 1, 0 for none) sets the lighting strength. The vector backend draws splats as ordinary points and refuses panels with more markers than the option ggplot3d.vector_markers (default 50000).

Text in a plane: geom_text_3d(orientation = "plane", plane = "xy") lays each label flat in the plane through its position spanned by two axes ("xy", "xz" or "yz"), read along the first axis and turned within the plane by the angle aesthetic. The label is cut from the glyph outlines of its font (read with the 'systemfonts' package) into faces that the camera foreshortens and that hide and are hidden by the data; size is the text size at the camera target. Seen from behind the plane, a label reads in the turned direction instead of mirrored.

Normals and up hints refer to positions after scale normalization. The frame's local Jacobian followed by aspect scaling transforms plane tangents into displayed model space. Their cross product transforms normals by the inverse transpose, preserving perpendicularity under unequal aspect ratios and curved frames. Glyphs remain rigid in the local tangent plane. angle rotates within that plane. Camera-facing geometry is resolved for each panel at draw time in every static backend and follows camera movement in the HTML viewer.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(1, 3, 2), z = c(1, 2, 4),
                label = letters[1:3])
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z))
p + geom_point_3d(size = 3) + coord_3d()
cloud <- data.frame(x = rnorm(2000), y = rnorm(2000), z = rnorm(2000))
ggplot2::ggplot(cloud, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  geom_point_3d(render = "splat", size = 1) +
  coord_3d(backend = backend_3d("raster", dpi = 96))
p + geom_path_3d() + coord_3d()
p + geom_segment_3d(ggplot2::aes(xend = x, yend = y, zend = 0)) + coord_3d()
p + geom_text_3d(ggplot2::aes(label = label)) + coord_3d()
if (requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p + geom_text_3d(ggplot2::aes(label = label), orientation = "plane", plane = "xy", size = 8) +
    coord_3d(projection = "perspective")
  p + geom_text_3d(ggplot2::aes(label = label), orientation = "plane",
    normal = c(1, 1, 1), up = c(0, 0, 1)) + coord_3d()
  p + geom_text_3d(ggplot2::aes(label = label), orientation = "plane",
    facing = "camera_point") + coord_3d(projection = "perspective")
}
p + geom_polygon_3d(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) + coord_3d()
